collectorPolicy.processIsolationFinding: All seventeen headed capture children completed under isolated process-group bounds with zero parent hard timeouts.
collectorPolicy.samplingFinding: Ten disjoint, unassigned domains received a fresh desktop capture. Five desktop pages passed the numeric machine gate; original-resolution review advanced Mary Jo Fabrics, Floor & Decor, and Mineral Tiles to distinct narrow queries. Review then exposed a generic collector defect: small fixed chat launchers covered card text on the two otherwise valid flooring pairs. A geometry- and semantics-bounded fix was unit-tested, and only those two frozen pairs were recaptured in both viewports. Both repaired pairs passed; no old partial capture was promoted.
